Rite 1st

You decide, silently, who "the house" is. Critical Success the target senses something tried to tip the odds against it and can't be targeted by your House Edge again today. Success unaffected. Failure the named target's next check before the start of your next turn takes a status penalty equal to your key ability modifier — or, if you named an ally or yourself instead, that creature gets the equivalent status bonus (no save needed for a willing beneficiary). Critical Failure as failure, and the penalty applies to the target's next two checks instead of one.

duration.value: until the start of your next turn
